validation.independent_unit: seed-level paired simulation replicate; the three arms use matched network and initial-condition seeds

design.seed_scheme: run_i * 997 + 7; edge permutation uses an independent seed offset

threshold_assignment.mean_threshold_only: unweighted mean over undirected network edges
threshold_assignment.randomized_threshold_only: uniform permutation of realized edge thresholds

multiplicity.pointwise: Holm correction across 21 p_HK points within each model contrast and metric
multiplicity.global: Holm correction across 12 global AUC tests

interpretation_boundary: Contrasts quantify the effect of assigning the realized edge-specific threshold distribution to its structural edges. They do not establish a causal mechanism outside this simulated network and parameter protocol.
